name: pocp
description: POCP (Proof of Change Protocol) for Claude Code: keeps coding agents working with POCP's checks instead of around them.

plugins.name: pocp
plugins.description: Sets up POCP with /pocp:setup, then stops Claude from skipping POCP's gate (--no-verify, hooksPath), force-pushing proven commits, or approving its own test and policy changes, and teaches it the POCP workflow.
